description: This file contains test cases for parsing command-line arguments and gateway detection functions in a Node.js project. It specifically tests functions like parseProcCmdline, parseWindowsCmdline, and isGatewayArgv, verifying their behavior with various input scenarios.

methods.name: parseProcCmdline
methods.description: Parses a null-delimited command line string into an array of arguments, trimming empty entries.

methods.name: parseWindowsCmdline
methods.description: Splits a Windows command line string into arguments, handling quotes and whitespace properly.

methods.name: isGatewayArgv
methods.description: Determines if a given array of command-line tokens indicates a gateway invocation based on known entry points or executable names.
